prompt: Pixel art in the style of a 1984 home-computer title screen, 16-colour palette, crisp square pixels with no anti-aliasing. A single phone stands upright in the centre of a deep indigo screen. Its thick light-purple border is striped with horizontal bands of one warm colour fading toward lavender, like a cassette loading. On the phone's screen, eight tiny 8x8 pixel symbols float in a row: a wave, a lightning bolt, a heart, a sun, a grumbling face, a crescent, a question mark, a rain cloud, each in its own colour. Faint motion trails behind each symbol show it hopping, floating, sinking or tilting. No words, no logos, no brand marks.

Pixel art triptych, 16-colour palette, crisp square pixels, deep indigo background. Three identical small phones side by side, each showing the same two chat bubbles. Left phone: its border is full of scrolling horizontal colour bands like a tape loader. Middle phone: tiny square sparks burst from a chat bubble and the phone is drawn slightly tilted as if shaking. Right phone: perfectly still, only a soft wash of blue fading into red across its top bar. No words, no logos, no brand marks.
